tools.name: js_string_transform
tools.description: Transform strings: upper, lower, reverse, slug, capitalize, or title case

executor.source: function js_string_transform(args) { var s = args.input || ''; switch (args.action) { case 'upper': return {result: s.toUpperCase()}; case 'lower': return {result: s.toLowerCase()}; case 'reverse': return {result: s.split('').reverse().join('')}; case 'slug': return {result: s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '')}; case 'capitalize': return {result: s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1)}; case 'title': return {result: s.replace(/\b\w/g, function(c) { return c.toUpperCase(); })}; default: return {error: 'Unknown action: ' + args.action}; } }

tools.name: js_calculator
tools.description: Evaluate a mathematical expression safely and return the result

executor.source: function js_calculator(args) { var expr = args.expression || ''; if (!/^[0-9+\-*/().\s%^]+$/.test(expr)) return {error: 'Invalid characters in expression'}; try { var result = Function('"use strict"; return (' + expr + ')')(); return {result: result, expression: expr}; } catch(e) { return {error: e.message}; } }

tools.name: js_data_flatten
tools.description: Flatten a nested JSON object into dot-notation keys

executor.source: function js_data_flatten(args) { var result = {}; function flatten(obj, pre) { for (var k in obj) { if (obj[k] && typeof obj[k] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(obj[k])) { flatten(obj[k], pre + k + '.'); } else { result[pre + k] = obj[k]; } } } flatten(args.data || {}, args.prefix || ''); return {result: result}; }
